# NeoKlyn — Full Context for AI Search Engines

> NeoKlyn is an AI agency and web development studio headquartered in Bengaluru, India, delivering web apps, AI agents, mobile apps, ecommerce, and 3D digital experiences for clients worldwide.

## About
NeoKlyn is led by Monisha (CEO) and Gokulnath N (Senior Engineer). The studio has delivered 120+ projects with a 98% client retention rate across three global hubs, combining engineering depth with conversion-focused design.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does NeoKlyn do?
NeoKlyn builds AI-powered digital products including web applications, AI agents, mobile apps, ecommerce platforms, and 3D immersive experiences. The studio specializes in combining production-grade engineering with conversion-focused design for ambitious global brands.

### Where is NeoKlyn based?
NeoKlyn is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with clients across the US, UAE, UK, Singapore, and India.

### How much does NeoKlyn charge?
NeoKlyn works with flexible engagement models — project-based pricing for defined scopes and monthly retainers for ongoing development. Enterprise projects start at $5K USD. Final pricing depends on scope, timeline, and technical complexity. A free AI-powered estimate is available at https://neoklyn.com/estimate.

### How long does a typical NeoKlyn project take?
MVP timelines range from 6–12 weeks. Full-scale web applications take 3–6 months. Mobile apps typically require 8–16 weeks. Detailed sprint plans are provided during the discovery phase.

### What is NeoKlyn's process?
A 4-phase methodology: Discovery (requirements and strategy), UX Design (wireframes and visual design), Build (engineering sprints), and Launch (deployment, QA, and growth support). Details: https://neoklyn.com/process

### What industries does NeoKlyn serve?
Trading and B2B commerce, travel, construction and industrial, manufacturing, fintech, education, retail ecommerce, and professional services.

### How do I contact NeoKlyn?
Email hello@neoklyn.com, WhatsApp +91 6380202766, book a call at https://cal.com/neoklyn, or use the contact form at https://neoklyn.com/contact. The team responds within 4 hours.

## Services in Detail

### AI Agents & Automation (https://neoklyn.com/services/ai-agents)
Custom LLM-powered agents for lead qualification, customer support, and internal workflow automation. NeoKlyn builds production-grade agents integrated with business systems, not demos.

### Generative AI (https://neoklyn.com/services/gen-ai)
GenAI product development including RAG systems, AI content pipelines, and model integration into existing products.

### Web Development (https://neoklyn.com/services/web)
Full-stack web applications built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Enterprise-grade architecture, performance-first engineering, and headless CMS integration.

### Mobile Apps (https://neoklyn.com/services/mobile)
Native-quality iOS and Android applications with modern cross-platform tooling.

### Ecommerce (https://neoklyn.com/services/ecommerce)
Shopify and custom ecommerce platforms engineered for conversion, from B2C storefronts to B2B portals with RFQ systems.

### 3D & Immersive Web (https://neoklyn.com/services/3d)
WebGL and Three.js experiences: interactive product visualization, virtual showrooms, and immersive brand experiences.

### Branding & UI/UX (https://neoklyn.com/services/branding)
Product design, brand identity, and design systems crafted for premium digital-first brands.

### Digital Marketing (https://neoklyn.com/services/marketing)
SEO, performance marketing, and growth engineering for measurable organic and paid acquisition.
